title: Five kings against Gibeon
english: [[Adoni-zedek and five kings besiege Gibeon, Israel’s ally >> Bible:Joshua 10:1-5]]. They cry to Jesus; he goes up by night. The Lord throws enemies into panic; [[hailstones from heaven >> Bible:Joshua 10:11]]. Figure: nations against the church joined by Christ’s covenant.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Sun stand over Gibeon
english: [[Sun, stand over Gibeon, and moon over the valley of Aijalon >> Bible:Joshua 10:12]] — a longer day. Heretics carp; we confess God’s power over the elements. The [[sun of righteousness >> Bible:Malachi 4:2]] does not set while we fight the spiritual war.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Kings in the cave sealed
english: [[Five kings hide in the cave at Makkedah — seal the cave >> Bible:Joshua 10:16-18]]. After victory they are brought out and captains set feet on their necks — spiritual foes underfoot. [[They are hanged on trees until evening >> Bible:Joshua 10:26]]. Glory to Jesus. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).
